snippet.title: Eternal Degrade - First look
snippet.description:
ED : Simulation Preview 1 is available for free on virus.run

Eternal Degrade is a Strategy RPG that runs in a custom simulation-focused game engine. The game features multiple depth levels of software-driven entertainment. StepBack Engine is made from the ground up to support simulations with coherent time travel and output complex multi-layer visuals in pure text rendering.

Epoch-638:391, Arfyvex Research Labs
https://virus.run
